# Polyfills by dialect

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_polyfill_docs.py from provisa/transpiler/polyfill: do not edit by hand. -->

A polyfill is how Provisa gives a PostgreSQL client PostgreSQL's behaviour on a connector dialect Provisa sends SQL to: a serving engine's, or a source's a statement is sent to directly. Each dialect below has a table of every feature that has a polyfill or a limitation there: its read polyfill, read limitations, write polyfill and write limitations. A feature the dialect does natively with no difference from PostgreSQL is left out and counted. Each dialect's page prints the same table with the rules it runs.

## [PostgreSQL](postgres.md)

144 of the grid's 144 features are native on PostgreSQL and left out.

<table><thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Read polyfill</th><th>Read limitations</th><th>Write polyfill</th><th>Write limitations</th></tr></thead><tbody>
</tbody></table>

## [Trino](trino.md)

1 of the grid's 144 features are native on Trino and left out.
